newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid bourse shakes off profit-taking to end flat.
newsitem.headline: Madrid bourse shakes off profit-taking to end flat.

text.p: The Madrid bourse ended largely flat on Friday when a bout of late buying turned the market around after a dull session plagued by profit-taking.
The general index ended up 0.49 points, 0.08 percent, to 625.79, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares closed down 0.11 points at 7,174.30.
Telefonica outperformed the indices, rising 1.34 pct to 4,550.
Turnover reaches almost 100 billion pesetas. Block trades accounted for almost 40 billion of this.
"After the strong gains of recent sessions we have seen some profit taking and we have taken advantage of this to square our books," said one dealer.
Traders said the session had been quiet with little corporate news and the U.S. closed for independence day and it had not taken much to push the market lower.
But earlier profit-taking had opened the way for further gains and traders remained optimistic about the medium-term outlook.
